worker: Why did the background job run twice when the machine came back?
After host recovery, the consumer executed the same task again because the visibility timeout expired before acknowledgment.
WorkerLeaseV2 renews the reservation before each long-running batch.
catalog: Why did typing one letter freeze the picker?
Autocomplete blocked the UI thread while scanning every indexed product on each keystroke.
CatalogCursor preserves a stable tie-breaker when products share a display name.

identity: Why did people have to sign in again after leaving a tab idle?
Inactive browser sessions lost their authentication because refresh cookies expired before the next interaction.
Can someone with an email invite accept it after the owner cancels it?
Revoked invitations were still redeemable because the acceptance handler checked the signature but omitted the revocation lookup.
How did we stop lots of failed password guesses from locking everyone out?
Rate limiting switched from a tenant-wide login counter to per-account and per-IP buckets so one brute-force attempt cannot deny other users access.
Why were phone users briefly getting the previous account after switching profiles?
The mobile client reused the former principal because the switch callback read a stale credential snapshot.
What was the workaround for RefreshNonceMismatch?
RefreshNonceMismatch disappeared when concurrent token rotation shared a single nonce update.
The auth.session_clock offset moved into the injected clock to stabilize expiry tests.
dispatch: How did a dying worker cause the same job to be handled twice?
A consumer crash after the external side effect but before acknowledgment triggered redelivery. The idempotency key belongs on the effect.
What kept urgent work from starving behind the big nightly batch?
Priority scheduling now reserves a consumer slot for interactive requests while bulk jobs occupy the rest of the pool.
Why was the backlog growing although machines were sitting idle?
Queue partitions were pinned unevenly. One busy shard held most messages while other executors had spare capacity.
What did we do with messages that can never be processed?
Poison payloads move to a dead-letter stream after the retry ceiling, with the original envelope kept for diagnosis.
DrainBarrier waits for acknowledgments before the process finishes graceful shutdown.
DISPATCH_LEASE_MS must exceed the longest acknowledgment round-trip under normal load.
migrations: Why did the upgrade look complete when old rows were still missing values?
The schema migration marked its checkpoint before the data backfill transaction committed. Restart could skip unfilled records.
How did we make the column rename safe during rolling deploys?
Writers temporarily emitted both field names while older application instances continued reading the original field.
What happened if the process died half way through copying the table?
The copy resumes from the last committed primary key. Intermediate staging rows are replaced by idempotent upserts.
What made the database refuse writes while we added the index?
The migration used a blocking DDL operation that held an exclusive lock during index construction.
SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT was resolved by restarting the entire read-to-write transaction after another writer committed.
SchemaEpochFence stops older binaries from writing once the new schema becomes mandatory.
cache: Why did customers still see the old price right after a save?
A cache invalidation race let a reader repopulate the previous catalog value between the eviction and database commit.
How did we stop many requests from rebuilding the same expired entry at once?
Single-flight refresh coalesces concurrent misses for one key, preventing a stampede when the TTL expires.
Why did the service run out of memory although the number of cached items barely changed?
The eviction policy counted entries instead of bytes, so larger response bodies consumed the process heap.
How could one region show the update long before another did?
Cross-region replicas rely on asynchronous invalidation delivery. A delayed subscriber continued serving stale values.
Why was VersionedCacheKey used on reads?
VersionedCacheKey includes the schema version so incompatible serialized payloads cannot share an entry.
The cache.ttl_jitter setting spreads expiration times across otherwise synchronized entries.
billing: What protected buyers when they clicked pay twice after the screen hung?
Payment retries now use one idempotency key per checkout so a repeated submission cannot create a second charge.
Why was the total off by a penny for some baskets?
The invoice rounded each line before adding taxes. Summing unrounded amounts first avoids cumulative cent drift.
Why could the dashboard say unpaid after the bank already sent the money back?
A late provider webhook overwrote the newer refund state because updates applied in arrival order instead of event order.
Why did only customers overseas get charged on the wrong date?
The renewal calculation used UTC midnight instead of the subscription's billing timezone, shifting the local calendar day.
What does LedgerReconcileV2 do with unmatched entries?
LedgerReconcileV2 places unmatched settlement rows in a review queue with the original reference.
billing.refund_pending clears after the provider confirmation is persisted, inside the same transaction.
storage: Why did documents downloaded after a retry sometimes have a chunk missing?
The multipart upload reused a part number after a transient failure, replacing an already uploaded segment.
How can we remove old files without deleting ones that are still in use?
Garbage collection traverses live manifest references and waits through the retention grace period before purging unreferenced objects.
What let us tell that copied data was damaged even though the copy finished?
The replication task compares the source and destination checksums after transfer to detect silent corruption.
Why did a file appear in listings before it could actually be opened?
The catalog published object metadata before the blob write was durable, exposing an unreadable entry.
BlobCommitFence requires durable write confirmation before committing the manifest pointer.
When does storage.copy_resume restart the transfer?
storage.copy_resume discards the saved offset if the source generation changed.
